## Contributing

Contributions are welcome. See [docs/contributing.md](docs/contributing.md) for
development setup, coding standards, and the pull request process.

Contributors are added to this file as their changes are merged.

## Upstream

Graft is a Go reimplementation of [spruce](https://github.com/geofffranks/spruce)
by Geoff Franks, and reproduces portions of its design and behavior. See
[LICENSE](LICENSE) for the upstream copyright notice and
[docs/spruce/](docs/spruce/README.md) for where the two tools agree and diverge.
